correctness.rationale: In normal coordinates J(x)=1-Ric(x,x)/6+O(r³), while d(exp x,exp y)²=|x-y|²-R(x,y,y,x)/3+O(r^5). Euclidean ball radial moments and quotient normalization yield a measure-Jacobian correction -4Scal r^4/[3(n+4)(n+2)^2]. Independence/tensor contraction yields a distance correction -Scal r^4/[3(n+2)^2]. Their sum is -(n+8)Scal r^4/[3(n+2)^2(n+4)] with r² leading term 2nr²/(n+2). Independent exact rational arithmetic verified the coefficient for dimensions 2 through 24; space-form quadrature at radii 0.3, 0.2, 0.14 converged to coefficient -10/288 in dimension two for both curvature signs. Uniform normal-coordinate expansions, not finite numerical tests, prove the all-n formula.
